title: A professional automotive concept design
prompt:
A professional automotive concept design board featuring a Bugatti Veyron Chrome Red transformed into a futuristic widebody performance concept.

The central image is an ultra-photorealistic CGI render of the modified Bugatti Veyron finished in glossy Chrome Red and exposed carbon fiber.

The vehicle features:

extremely low stance
OEM-inspired widebody
aggressive front splitter
side skirts
rear diffuser
small GT spoiler
premium forged multi-spoke wheels
large performance brakes
LED lighting
carbon fiber aerodynamic details
race-inspired body modifications integrated naturally into the original Bugatti design.

Surrounding the central render are highly accurate engineering drawings.

IMPORTANT:

The front view, rear view, side view and top view MUST be hand-drawn graphite pencil sketches only.

No color.

No rendering.

Only monochrome pencil linework with realistic cross-hatching, construction lines, perspective guides, engineering dimensions and drafting annotations.

The upper technical drawings should resemble an automotive designer's original concept sketches made with graphite pencils on drafting paper.

Below the main render include:

exploded wheel assembly
coilover suspension drawing
brake rotor technical illustration
body kit exploded components
engineering measurements in millimeters
construction geometry
callouts
technical notes
automotive blueprint graphics

The central Bugatti remains fully photorealistic while every surrounding technical drawing is monochrome graphite pencil artwork.
